author: Rob Keck (knkwebservices)
install_msg: Thanks for adding the fallout76-cog repo! Install the `fallout76` cog to get started: `[p]cog install fallout76-cog fallout76`
short: Fallout 76 nuke codes and Minerva's schedule.
description: A small collection of cogs for Fallout 76 players. Currently includes `fallout76`: live nuke launch codes (via NukaCrypt) and a manually-maintained schedule for Minerva's rotating vendor location.
